listTenLoanRequest.assessment: The pinned RM2PT specification selects every REFERENCESVALIDATED request, assigns the collection to CurrentLoanRequests and returns it. Despite the legacy name, it specifies no ten-item limit or ordering. V2 checks exact unordered membership in both outputs.

listAvaiableLoanTerm.assessment: The pinned RM2PT specification has no guard and returns every registered LoanTerm. It does not require repository-array identity, ordering or an additional repository frame clause. V2 checks exact unordered result membership against an independent expected list.
